title: unit
intro:
Specify units of physical quatities.
   Daisy will recognise both the build-in and user defined units, and convert be-
tween different units representing the same physical dimension. This is done by
converting to and from the base (usually defined by SI) unit for that dimension.

sections.name: SI
sections.desc: Base parameterization for all SI based units.
sections.sig:
< SI (time 0)
         (length 0)
         (mass 0)
         (electric current 0)
         (thermodynamic temperature 0)
         (amount of substance 0)
         (luminous intensity 0) >
